title: Quarter Zero handoff outline and pledge (Q4 planning) v0.1
content:
Purpose and audience:
This is a working one-page+notes for the company leadership, product and eng managers, and ops leads to run a compact Q4 launch / handoff. It's intended to: align cross-functional priorities, present draft OKRs for feedback, capture team-level pledges (micro-commitments) that drive confident all-hands messaging, and provide an exec-ready short list of asks and risks. Audience: execs, product leads, eng managers, SRE, People Ops.

Context (short):
- Momentum: Hosted API adoption + Dedicated early customers are both up MoM; cost pressure on production token spend is rising.
- Priorities this quarter: reliability at scale, lowering per-token cost for high-throughput customers, and shipping Private deployment baseline for one regulated pilot.
- This doc is intentionally compact: we want a single-slice narrative for the all-hands and an internal handoff checklist for teams.

Top-level draft Objectives (company-level OKRs) - V0.1 (metrics are draft and require validation from Eng and Finance):
O1: Reduce average production per-token cost by 18% while preserving response quality for top 10 customers.
  - KR1.1: Implement prefix/KV caching across top-5 request routes and reduce token count by 10%.
  - KR1.2: Roll out quantization profile for 2 model families used by >60% of hosted traffic resulting in 12% GPU-second reduction.
  - KR1.3: Negotiate cost baseline for Dedicated customers covering at least $1.2M committed spend.
O2: Improve system resilience so customer-visible latency P95 for interactive routes is <= 350ms in our primary region.
  - KR2.1: Introduce request-priority routing and failover for region/variant mismatch; verify end-to-end in canary.
  - KR2.2: Reduce SRE mean time to mitigate (MTTM) for production incidents from current ~28m to <= 15m through playbook updates and runbook practice.
  - KR2.3: Launch tracing + token-level latency breakdown for all top 20 customers.
O3: Deliver a minimum viable Private deployment (VPC + baseline observability) to pilot customer and get first signed pilot contract.
  - KR3.1: Completed private control plane deployable in customer VPC evaluated by security review.
  - KR3.2: Documented onboarding checklist and 2 runbook drills with customer infra team.
  - KR3.3: Signed statement-of-work for first pilot by end of quarter.

Key initiatives (high-level owner tags):
- Cost tooling & Optimize suggestions (Product / Optimize) — owner: Sofia M.
- KV caching rollout (Serving Runtime) — owner: Devon P.
- Quantization baseline + perf bench (Applied ML) — owner: Rajan G.
- Circuits & routing failover (Platform Eng) — owner: Liam O.
- Private deployment MVP + security onboarding (Private Deployments) — owner: Maya C.
- Observability r.e. token-level metrics (Observability) — owner: Observability Eng lead (TBD)

Team pledges (micro-commitments to include on all-hands slides):
- Eng: "We will freeze non-critical infra changes for the first 4 weeks of the quarter to stabilize canary baselines." — lead: Liam O.
- Product: "We will prioritize top-3 customer routes for caching recommendations and provide sample prompt rewrites." — lead: Sofia M.
- SRE: "We will run four 1-hour runbook drills this quarter and publish incident CBLs (cause/behavior/lessons)." — lead: Devon P.
- Sales/CS: "We will secure at least 3 enterprise pilots and qualify 2 for Dedicated uplift." — lead: Sales Ops (TBD).

All-hands run-of-show (compact 25–30m):
- 0:00–0:03 Opening + one-line company state (CEO)
- 0:03–0:08 Product/Market signal + top customer stories (head of product)
- 0:08–0:15 Company OKRs & team pledges (Maya C.) — show 3 objectives, 1-line rationale each
- 0:15–0:22 Operational focus: reliability, cost, private pilot (SRE + Platform)
- 0:22–0:28 Ask ladder (what we need from the company: hiring, focus weeks, runway decisions) and honors for contributors
- 0:28–0:30 Quick Q&A + where to leave feedback (post on #company-q0-feedback)

Exec update bullets (for SLT slide pack):
- Positive traction: hosted API growth +14% QoQ in active ingestion customers; top-10 account spend up 22%.
- Risk: current caching/quantization roadmap is behind by ~3 weeks due to bench instability; mitigation: reallocate 0.3 FTE from noncritical efforts for 6 weeks.
- Ask: Exec sign-off on 2 hiring flex reels (Senior SRE, Applied ML infra) and approval to earmark $450k for Dedicated capacity trials.
- Decision needed: Acceptable per-token quality regression threshold for quantized models (options: 0.5% BLEU-equivalent or 1.0%).

Handoff checklist (practical items to complete before public all-hands):
- [ ] Finalize numeric KRs with Finance & Eng performance team (owner: Maya)
- [ ] Generate 1-slide animation of P95 latency trend and caching impact (owner: Observability)
- [ ] Confirm private pilot SOW template with Legal (owner: Rajan)
- [ ] Draft exec slide asking for hiring & budget approval (owner: CEO office)
- [ ] Sync HQ comms + external blog embargo dates (owner: Growth)
- [ ] Collect team pledge blurbs (deadline: next Tue EOD) (owner: Company Ops)

Risks and mitigations (short):
- R: Quantization causes subtle regressions in structured output for reranking workflows.
  - M: Gate quantized rollout behind evals targeted to reranking prompt sets + holdback policy.
- R: Dedicated capacity procurement windows slip and impact sales commitments.
  - M: Offer interim burst credits and adjust SOW to include contingency SLAs; prioritize 30% reserved slots for pilots.
- R: Observability cost explosion when we enable token-level retention for all customers.
  - M: Roll out token-level tracing to top-20 customers first and implement sampling; add cost dashboard.

Open questions for SLT feedback: (please comment inline in Confluence page linked above)
1) What is the prioritization among O1/O2/O3 if we have to rebalance an engineer pool of 5 people this quarter?
2) Is the 18% target for cost reduction aggressive given current model mix? Accept or adjust?
3) For team pledges, are we comfortable with the proposed 4-week engineering freeze window?

Notes to self / working checklist for product-ops (Maya):
- Keep the all-hands script tight: no more than 3 slides per objective, 1 customer quote, 2 concrete asks.
- Prepare 1-pager for managers with talking points and 'what to say to your team' section.
- Coordinate rehearsal with CEO + leads one day prior.

Appendix — snapshot metrics (last 7 days / draft):
- Hosted API active ingestion accounts: 412 (+14% QoQ)
- Top-10 accounts combined spend: $1.82M (MTD)
- Baseline P95 latency (interactive primary region): 410ms (target 350ms)
- Current estimate per-token cost (production-weighted): $0.00058/token
- KV cache enabled routes (production): 7/20 planned

Related artifacts and where to comment:
- Confluence draft: https://confluence.redwood.ai/pages/Q0-handoff-2026
- Jira epic for OKR tracking: ENG-4891
- Draft PR for all-hands slides: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/1423

Next steps (owners & timeline):
- This week: collect pledge blurbs, confirm metrics with Observability (owners: team leads, due Fri)
- Next week: final numeric KRs from Finance, draft exec ask slide (owners: Maya + CFO office, due Wed)
- 2 weeks: rehearsal + slide freeze (owner: CEO office)

If you want changes before I fold into the exec pack, add inline comments on the Confluence linked above or ping me (Maya) in #company-ops.

-- end working draft --

(Formatting notes: this is a working doc — expect bullet fragments, TODOs, and placeholders. We'll convert the top section into a 3-slide exec pack and a single-email all-hands announcement.)
